ambiguities.fragment: If a window of the car is damaged and the interior surveillance of the car detects an intruder or a door of the car is opened without a car key
ambiguities.explanation: The logical operator 'or' connects two distinct conditions (intruder detection and door opening), but it is unclear whether the 'and' condition applies to both parts of the 'or' clause (conjunction of all three) or only to the first part (conjunction of the first two, disjunction of the second).
possible_interpretations: The alarm shall raise if (a window is damaged AND an intruder is detected) OR (a door is opened without a key).
The alarm shall raise if (a window is damaged AND an intruder is detected AND a door is opened without a key).
textual_evidence: If a window of the car is damaged and the interior surveillance of the car detects an intruder or a door of the car is opened without a car key
